text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute delivered a wonderful run. 
And in a race where she clashed 
passionately with her juniors,
she learned 
the importance of living with all one's 
might until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Retirement canceled. Wonder Acute, whose 
desire to run more and win many more
races 
had reignited...
